Module org.apache.jena.core
Package org.apache.jena.mem.collection

Interface JenaSetHashOptimized<E>

Type Parameters:
E - the element type of the set
All Superinterfaces:
Iterable<E>, JenaMapSetCommon<E>, JenaSet<E>, Sized
All Known Subinterfaces:
FastTripleBunch, JenaSetIndexed<E>
All Known Implementing Classes:
FastArrayBunch, FastHashedTripleBunch, FastHashSet, TripleSet, TripleSet
public interface JenaSetHashOptimized<E> extends JenaSet<E>
Extension of JenaSet that lets callers supply a precomputed hash code.

Attention: any caller-supplied hash code MUST equal E.hashCode(); if it does not, the set will misbehave.
